description: GET ONLY the 'ImageData' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Dictionary<string,string> of arbitrary named image asset URLs/paths for the Title — splash screens, banners, icons, loading screens, marketing art. Key is a project-defined slug (e.g. "main_banner", "login_bg"), value is a URL or storage path. For per-currency icons use Currency.VirtualCurrencies[].AssetPaths; for per-item icons use Item; for character art use Character.
name: get_image_data
title: Get Image Data settings
